title: R: programming, statistical computing and visualization
summary: 60 lessons covering R fundamentals, functions, data workflows, S3/S4/R6/S7 objects, statistical models and base, ggplot2 and Plotly visualization.

lessons.title: Run an R script and inspect its result
lessons.outcome: Run a self-contained calculation and distinguish printed output, saved source and a successful check.
lessons.lab: Construct a script for subtotal 20 plus fee 3.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: 18 saved_total 18; recalculated 24.

lessons.title: Numbers, types and approximate equality
lessons.outcome: Inspect numeric types and choose an equality check that matches the numerical contract.
lessons.lab: Check that 19 items form three groups of five with four left.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: integer and double. Approximately 0.3; three groups and two remaining.

lessons.title: Atomic vectors, lengths and recycling
lessons.outcome: Write vectorized calculations while rejecting accidental recycling and unintended coercion.
lessons.lab: Write a guard allowing one fee or one fee per amount.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: 12, 22, 32. 11, 22, 31, 42; per-row lengths are invalid.

lessons.title: Logical vectors, comparisons and three-valued reasoning
lessons.outcome: Build explicit selection predicates and handle unknown values without turning them into false evidence.
lessons.lab: Construct a mask for known amounts from ten through twenty inclusive.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE. FALSE; no empty-vector extraction error.

lessons.title: Index by position, name and an explicit mask
lessons.outcome: Select and replace vector elements without confusing positions, exclusions and unknown masks.
lessons.lab: Select and update a validated named value.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: C 30, A 10, A 10. raw contains 10 and NA; known contains 10.

lessons.title: Missing values, NULL, NaN and infinity
lessons.outcome: Choose and test a missingness policy that preserves the distinction between absence, undefined arithmetic and zero.
lessons.lab: Construct a finite-only mask for c(2, Inf, NA,4).
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Only zero and four are finite. Observed count zero; reported sum NA.

lessons.title: Names, attributes and ordinary value semantics
lessons.outcome: Explain why ordinary vector updates differ from mutations of reference objects and why attributes matter.
lessons.lab: Construct a two-column shape from four numbers.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Original A is one; edited A is 99. 2.

lessons.title: Matrices, dimensions and linear algebra operators
lessons.outcome: Construct and subset matrices while distinguishing elementwise arithmetic from a matrix product.
lessons.lab: Compute predictions for intercept two and slope three at x=3,4.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: 2,5,8 in a 3 by 1 matrix. Solution 3,2; residual below tolerance.

lessons.title: Lists and nested records without accidental flattening
lessons.outcome: Read and update nested records while preserving heterogeneous fields and validating required components.
lessons.lab: Validate required id and values fields.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: 2,4. Only id remains after deletion.

lessons.title: Data frames, column types and record identity
lessons.outcome: Create a typed table, select records safely and verify its grain and key instead of relying on row positions.
lessons.lab: Validate a nonmissing unique ID column.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: A10, B20, C30. A one-row one-column data frame with amount 30.

lessons.title: Branching, loops and empty-input behavior
lessons.outcome: Implement bounded loops with explicit scalar conditions, empty-input behavior and predictable output shape.
lessons.lab: Construct a loop summing only positive values.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: 4,16,36. Three steps; remaining 2.5.

lessons.title: Functions, arguments and return contracts
lessons.outcome: Define reusable functions with validated inputs, explicit defaults and testable return values.
lessons.lab: Write a function returning count and total.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: 9,18. Count 2, total 6; empty count 0.

lessons.title: Lexical scope, closures and lazy arguments
lessons.outcome: Explain captured configuration and lazy argument timing without relying on hidden global state.
lessons.lab: Capture a threshold at construction time.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: 8 and 12. Lazy 15; fixed 6.

lessons.title: Functional iteration, typed results and the base pipe
lessons.outcome: Map a validated computation over records and retain predictable output types with readable data flow.
lessons.lab: Map count and mean into a list per group.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Named totals A = 3 and B = 10. 1,2.

lessons.title: Errors, warnings and structured recovery
lessons.outcome: Recover from expected input failures without concealing programming defects or dropping diagnostics.
lessons.lab: Return structured status, value and diagnostic fields.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: okFALSE with the digit-only diagnostic. Value 4 and one recorded notice.

lessons.title: Strings, encodings and explicit text parsing
lessons.outcome: Normalize and parse small text records with explicit patterns while preserving identifiers and Unicode meaning.
lessons.lab: Split "A|12" on a literal pipe.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Only 0017 is valid. Four characters and five bytes.

lessons.title: Factors, levels and model interpretation
lessons.outcome: Represent categories explicitly and avoid interpreting internal factor codes as measurements.
lessons.lab: Retain an unused C level in a table.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Labels 10,20,10; codes 1,2,1. A2, B0, C0.

lessons.title: Dates, instants and explicit time zones
lessons.outcome: Parse dates and timestamps with explicit formats and zones, distinguishing calendar labels from elapsed time.
lessons.lab: Parse an explicit ISO calendar date.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: February 28, February 29, March 1. 12:00 UTC and 07:00 NewYork; elapsed 90 minutes.

lessons.title: Local files, CSV, JSON and RDS contracts
lessons.outcome: Round-trip small local data through appropriate formats while verifying types, missingness and cleanup.
lessons.lab: Round-trip one trusted R object with attributes.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: IDs 001,002; second amountNA. JSONrecord and exact factor round trip.

lessons.title: Debugging, regression checks and reproducible scripts
lessons.outcome: Reduce a defect to a small case and build behavioral checks that cover ordinary, boundary and rejected inputs.
lessons.lab: Add tests for mismatched lengths and zero total weight.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: 17.5 under both weight scales. The two vectors match exactly in this run.

lessons.title: S3 value objects, validation and generic dispatch
lessons.outcome: Build a validated S3 measurement value, dispatch a domain-specific generic and reject malformed objects at the public boundary.
lessons.lab: Implement an observed-count generic for measurement objects.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: A named numeric total ms=6. Original total 6, copied total 104; forged and unsupported inputs rejected.

lessons.title: S4 slots, validity and multiple dispatch
lessons.outcome: Define an S4 measurement with cross-slot invariants and select methods using both argument classes.
lessons.lab: Construct a new object with an infinite measurement.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: A FormalMeasure with values 2,4,6 and unit ms. Three expected errors, each matched to its cause.

lessons.title: R6 identity, encapsulation and cloning
lessons.outcome: Trace shared R6 identity, protect state through methods and distinguish shallow from nested-R6 deep cloning.
lessons.lab: Verify that a rejected negative increment leaves the counter unchanged.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Alias reads 5; independent clone reads 9. Original 3, shallow 3, deep 6.

lessons.title: S7 properties, validators and generic methods
lessons.outcome: Use the pinned S7 property and method API to construct valid values, reject invalid replacement and dispatch across two typed arguments.
lessons.lab: Add a series_count generic returning the number of observations.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: A joined vector 2,4,6 and total ms=12. Three expected failures; the original value remains valid.

lessons.title: Object interoperability and public data contracts
lessons.outcome: Convert S3, S4, R6 and S7 values through validated adapters and inspect ggplot2 through public build interfaces.
lessons.lab: Write an S7 adapter using its declared properties.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Mean 3, count 2, unit ms for both representations. Coordinates(1,8),(2,5),(3,6) and the prepared package version.

lessons.title: Namespaces, dependency declarations and package boundaries
lessons.outcome: Use exported namespace-qualified functions and inspect a local package source layout without confusing sourced definitions with an installed package.
lessons.lab: Create and inspect DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE and one R source file in a temporary tree.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Masked result -999; exported stats result 4. Three expected source files and mean 3; the temporary directory is removed.

lessons.title: Profile equivalent work and account for allocations
lessons.outcome: Compare numerically equivalent R implementations, collect bounded timing and profiling evidence, and explain its measurement limits.
lessons.lab: Measure both implementations with the same fixture and repetitions.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Equivalent results, nonnegative timings, input size and a bounded profile summary. Positive object size; allocation event count or explicit unavailable value.

lessons.title: Bounded local parallelism and task-owned random streams
lessons.outcome: Execute fixed independent tasks with two local PSOCK workers, preserve deterministic task results and close worker processes on every ordinary exit path.
lessons.lab: Implement a self-contained task that returns count and squared sum.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Squared-sum results 14 and 77, equal to the serial computation. Four task means; exact equality by identity across the two schedules.

lessons.title: Reproducibility, RNG scope and analysis metadata
lessons.outcome: Run repeatable stochastic calculations without leaking caller RNG state and record a bounded configuration, input digest and software-version ledger.
lessons.lab: Test the case where .Random.seed did not exist before the call.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Identical five-value vectors and unchanged caller RNG state. Configuration, two 64-character digests, R/package versions and RNG kinds.

lessons.title: Analytical-package capstone with explicit value and data contracts
lessons.outcome: Assemble a tested analytical value object with unique record identity, explicit missingness, compatible aggregation and a documented package continuation.
lessons.lab: Independently implement and test the duplicate-ID and equal-length constructor rules.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Four rows, three observed, one missing; mean 16/3 ms. Both invalid combinations rejected; all-missing mean NA and observed count 0.

lessons.title: Transform records with explicit selection and ordering
lessons.outcome: Build an auditable table transformation whose row population, units and key alignment remain inspectable.
lessons.lab: Return an exclusion count alongside the selected table.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: L1=8, L3=9. 20 in either order.

lessons.title: Grouped summaries and sufficient aggregation state
lessons.outcome: Aggregate groups while preserving missingness counts and enough state to reconstruct the intended overall mean.
lessons.lab: Return rows, observed, missing, sum and mean per group.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: 25 versus 20. Arows 2/observed 1; Crows 0/meanNA.

lessons.title: Joins, key uniqueness and unmatched records
lessons.outcome: Perform a validated many-to-one lookup and detect duplicate or unmatched keys before they change totals.
lessons.lab: Write a many-to-one join guard.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Three rows, total 60. Three rows, total 40 instead of 30.

lessons.title: Long and wide tables with explicit cell keys
lessons.outcome: Reshape repeated measurements only after validating the observation key and deciding how missing cells are represented.
lessons.lab: Reverse a complete wide table to long form.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: A10/12;B20/23. B visit 2 isNA.

lessons.title: Validate ingestion and preserve rejected-record evidence
lessons.outcome: Validate a small ingestion boundary without silently coercing, dropping or repairing invalid records.
lessons.lab: Return admitted and quarantined tables with stable IDs.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: One admitted row, three rejected rows. The malformed batch is rejected.

lessons.title: Chunked aggregation and memory-aware data contracts
lessons.outcome: Combine chunk-level sufficient statistics correctly and distinguish a memory strategy from a performance claim.
lessons.lab: Implement an all-missing finalization rule.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Count 4, total 100, mean 25. Observed 3, missing 2, total 9.

lessons.title: Simulation, Monte Carlo error and reproducible randomness
lessons.outcome: Use a small simulation to investigate a probability while separating simulation error from model uncertainty.
lessons.lab: Simulate an event and retain seed, B, estimate and error estimate.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Estimate near 0.3125 with finite simulation error. Approximately 0.0458 and 0.0229.

lessons.title: Finite probability tables and conditional reasoning
lessons.outcome: Compute and reconcile conditional probabilities from a finite original table without confusing the conditioning direction.
lessons.lab: Construct joint probabilities from the count table.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: 0.3 versus 0.75. Alert probability 0.2; reverse conditional 0.75.

lessons.title: Formulas, design matrices and identifiability
lessons.outcome: Inspect the numeric design implied by a formula before interpreting coefficients or fitting a model.
lessons.lab: Inspect and validate a design before fitting.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Four identifiable columns for these four distinct rows. Three columns, rank two.

lessons.title: An auditable analytical pipeline capstone
lessons.outcome: Deliver a self-contained analysis that validates inputs, joins metadata, summarizes groups and reports a bounded conclusion.
lessons.lab: Assemble validate, enrich, summarize into one callable pipeline.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Three admitted records, total 70. Alpha count 1, total 10, mean 10; Beta count 2, total 60, mean 30.

lessons.title: Explore distributions and preserve missingness
lessons.outcome: Produce a descriptive summary whose observation counts, missing-value policy and distributional limits are explicit.
lessons.lab: Construct group summaries for A=c(1,NA) and B=c(4,6,NA), retaining observed counts.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Rows 5, observed 3, missing 2, observed mean 11/3. Mean 21.6 and median 2; the four smaller values have mean and median 2.

lessons.title: Estimation, standard errors and resampling targets
lessons.outcome: Calculate and interpret distinct uncertainty quantities while keeping the resampling population and assumptions explicit.
lessons.lab: Enumerate all four-draw bootstrap samples and verify their conditional variance.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Mean 5; sample variance 20/3; squared SE 5/3. 256 resamples; mean 5; conditional variance 1.25.

lessons.title: Linear models, design matrices and diagnostic limits
lessons.outcome: Connect an R model formula to its numerical design matrix, fitted coefficients and diagnostic assumptions.
lessons.lab: Fit y~x*group to two exact group lines A:1+2x and B:4+x.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Intercept 1, slope 1.8, residual sum near 0, RSS 0.8. Same fitted mean; wider future-observation interval.

lessons.title: Binomial GLMs, probabilities and calibration
lessons.outcome: Translate a logistic model between its link scale, probabilities and evaluation quantities without confusing their interpretations.
lessons.lab: Calculate the trial-weighted Brier score.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Probabilities 0.2/0.6; odds ratio 6. Brier 0.2, threshold accuracy 0.7, finite log loss.

lessons.title: Structured validation and training-only preprocessing
lessons.outcome: Construct validation procedures whose partitions and preprocessing match the intended transfer claim.
lessons.lab: Perform leave-one-group-out prediction for the exact rule y=1+2x.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: No shared row IDs can coexist with four shared groups; group split has zero shared groups. Training center1; global center51; valid held-out transformed values 99/101.

lessons.title: PCA, scaling and reconstruction
lessons.outcome: Fit and inspect PCA while preserving its preprocessing, orientation and interpretation contracts.
lessons.lab: Reverse the first loading and score signs together.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Raw large-unit loading magnitude10/sqrt101; standardized magnitudes1/sqrt2. Near-exact reconstruction and orthonormal loading columns.

lessons.title: Decision trees, complexity and held-out decisions
lessons.outcome: Fit a small rpart classifier and distinguish its partition, probability output, complexity policy and generalization limits.
lessons.lab: Prune with cp 1 and count terminal leaves.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Two leaves; classes low/high; probability rows sum to 1. One terminal root after pruning.

lessons.title: Censoring, risk sets and survival models
lessons.outcome: Construct survival outcomes and inspect Kaplan-Meier and Cox calculations without treating censored observations as observed event times.
lessons.lab: Validate an event column before creating Surv.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Survival 0.75,0.75,0.375,0. Finite positive hazard ratio and two bounded survival curves.

lessons.title: Time series, ARIMA and rolling-origin evidence
lessons.outcome: Fit and evaluate a small time-series model while preserving temporal information boundaries and forecast targets.
lessons.lab: Construct rolling-origin naive predictions for origins 4 through 7 of 1:8.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Forecasts 0.2,0.1,0.05 with finite nonnegative SEs. Four one-step forecasts, all errors1, MSE 1.

lessons.title: Scientific synthesis and reproducible model comparison
lessons.outcome: Produce a small analytical report that connects the scientific question, model comparison, numerical evidence and limits.
lessons.lab: Reorder one candidate table and realign by ID before scoring.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Affine MSE 0.390625; quadratic error near zero on four authored held-out points. Metric and held-out count preserved through a local JSON round trip.

lessons.title: Base graphics, coordinates and owned devices
lessons.outcome: Construct a labeled base-R graphic and manage an explicitly owned file device without confusing drawing with browser delivery.
lessons.lab: Set and inspect exact limits 0:4 and 0:8.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: One base graphic; coordinate limits 0/4/0/8 and the line through all five points. A nonempty PNG with the expected signature, followed by owned cleanup.

lessons.title: Multiple panels, uncertainty and scale contracts
lessons.outcome: Build a compact uncertainty display whose panels, interval target and axis choices support a valid comparison.
lessons.lab: Draw raw observations and summaries with shared y limits.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: One two-panel graphic; group means 2.5/4.5 and explicitly constructed t intervals. Linear differences 9/90; log10 differences 1/1.

lessons.title: ggplot2 data mappings and layers
lessons.outcome: Construct and inspect a ggplot whose data, mappings and layer-specific responsibilities are explicit.
lessons.lab: Add a group-mean layer using its own data.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Four points, two group colours and shapes, one explicitly printed plot. Raw layer four rows; summary layer two means at y2 and 4.

lessons.title: ggplot2 statistics, geometries and grouping
lessons.outcome: Choose a statistic and grouping contract that matches whether the input contains raw observations or precomputed summaries.
lessons.lab: Diagnose geom_bar(aes(category,n)) with the default statistic.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Both plots have heights2/1/3, from different declared data representations. Six observations arranged into two line groups.

lessons.title: Scales, coordinates and facets change different contracts
lessons.outcome: Choose scale, coordinate and facet policies while explaining how each affects calculations and visual comparisons.
lessons.lab: Compare fixed and free-y facet scale assignments.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: The full-data fitted line differs from the line fitted after removing the extreme observation. Two panels with two y-scale assignments under free_y.

lessons.title: Statistical graphics for model diagnosis
lessons.outcome: Construct diagnostic graphics from fitted quantities and explain which model concerns they can investigate without treating a plot as proof.
lessons.lab: Construct a normal Q-Q graphic of those residuals.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Coefficients1/2 and eight correctly paired residual marks. Slope 2 with residual magnitude increasing exactly with fitted value.

lessons.title: Plotly traces and layout from explicit data
lessons.outcome: Construct and inspect a small Plotly figure whose trace data and layout correspond to a declared analytical view.
lessons.lab: Set axis titles through layout.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Two traces with observed 2/4/3 and rule2/4/6 values. Three bars with named categories and supplied heights2/1/3.

lessons.title: Hover, view controls and accessible alternatives
lessons.outcome: Encode a bounded interactive view while preserving observation identity and a non-hover-dependent explanation.
lessons.lab: Encode All and Group A visibility buttons for two known traces.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Two traces, retained IDs, an All/Group A control and a printed four-row table. Two retained observations in the actual figure data.

lessons.title: ggplotly translation and validation boundaries
lessons.outcome: Translate a supported ggplot to Plotly and verify retained data while identifying the visual and interaction properties that still require review.
lessons.lab: Add a mean reference line and inspect the translated structure.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Four retained source observations, one static figure and one converted figure. Four marker observations plus reference-line geometry.

lessons.title: Capstone: an analytical visualization with an evidence record
lessons.outcome: Build a linked numerical, static and interactive analysis whose denominators, identities, uncertainty and delivery limits can be reviewed.
lessons.lab: Construct a static raw-point and interval display from those tables.
lessons.verification: Reproduce the worked observations: Eight observed values, two missing values, group means 2.5/4.5 and squared SEs 5/12 and 17/12. Two mean marks with exact supplied t-interval half-widths.
